p3.ex2: On a diet, a grated and roasted mixture cuts out junk food entirely.
p3.example: She blended a nutritious mixture of herbs, seeds and dairy products in the saucepan.

p3.en: To eat something in small bites.
p3.ex1: He nibbled a quick bite of dairy products instead of a takeaway on a diet.
p3.ex2: On a diet, nibbling rather than gulping or slurping helps stick to a nutritious plan.
p3.example: She nibbled on a seed and herb mixture rather than gulping junk food on a full stomach.

p3.en: Containing substances the body needs to stay healthy.
p3.ex1: He blended a nutritious mixture of herbs and seeds in the saucepan instead.
p3.ex2: On a diet, a nutritious roast or bake prevents putting on weight from junk food.
p3.example: She replaced junk food takeaways with nutritious bakes rich in fibre and dairy.

p3.en: Eating less food or only certain types of food to lose weight.
p3.ex1: He nibbled rather than gulped — on a diet, every bite counts.
p3.ex2: On a diet, treating yourself to a quick bite of nutritious food is better than a takeaway.
p3.example: She was on a diet and cut junk food and takeaways out of her weekly plan.

p3.en: When you have already eaten recently.
p3.ex1: On a diet, eating on a full stomach leads to putting on weight quickly.
p3.ex2: She nibbled on a nutritious herb mixture on a full stomach to avoid a takeaway.
p3.example: He gulped junk food on a full stomach and had to burn off the extra calories.

p3.en: To become heavier.
p3.ex1: He put on weight gulping instant food on a full stomach instead of a nutritious bake.
p3.ex2: On a diet, cutting out junk food and frying prevents putting on weight.
p3.example: She put on weight after being addicted to junk food and takeaways.

p3.en: A small, quick meal or snack.
p3.ex1: He grabbed a quick bite of grated dairy and herb mixture from the saucepan.
p3.ex2: On a diet, a quick bite of nutritious food prevents gulping junk food on a full stomach.
p3.example: She had a quick bite of the nutritious left-over bake instead of a takeaway.

p3.en: To cook food in an oven or over a fire.
p3.ex1: He roasted the left-over mixture and turned it into a quick bite on a diet.
p3.ex2: On a diet, roasting rather than frying helps get in shape and avoid putting on weight.
p3.example: She roasted seeds and dairy products in a saucepan instead of frying junk food.

p3.en: A deep cooking pot with a long handle.
p3.ex1: He grated dairy products into the saucepan and baked them for a quick bite.
p3.ex2: On a diet, a saucepan bake or roast cuts out junk food and helps get in shape.
p3.example: She blended herbs and seeds in a saucepan to make a nutritious mixture.

p3.en: To drink in very small amounts.
p3.ex1: He sipped from the saucepan mixture on a diet instead of treating himself to a takeaway.
p3.ex2: On a diet, sipping rather than gulping or slurping avoids putting on weight.
p3.example: She sipped a blended herb mixture rather than gulping an instant junk drink.

p3.en: To cut something into thin, flat pieces.
p3.ex1: He sliced left-over roast and nibbled it as a quick bite rather than a takeaway.
p3.ex2: On a diet, slicing rather than chopping bulk helps stick to a nutritious serving plan.
p3.example: She sliced dairy products and herbs into the saucepan instead of a junk food bake.

p3.en: To eat or drink noisily.
p3.ex1: She avoided slurping and sipping on a diet — she chewed every quick bite slowly.
p3.ex2: On a diet, slurping rather than nibbling piles up junk food habits and puts on weight.
p3.example: He slurped the instant junk mixture on a full stomach instead of chewing carefully.

p3.en: A person who watches an event or activity without taking part.
p3.ex1: He was a spectator to his own health — watching others get in shape while gulping takeaways.
p3.ex2: On a diet, even as a spectator, cutting out junk food nibbles helps avoid putting on weight.
p3.example: As a spectator at the game, she nibbled junk food on a full stomach.

p3.en: To continue doing or using something without changing.
p3.ex1: He found it hard to stick to a diet while being addicted to instant junk takeaways.
p3.ex2: On a diet, sticking to a saucepan mixture of herbs and dairy prevents putting on weight.
p3.example: She stuck to a nutritious bake and roast plan to get in shape.

p3.en: To cause food or drink to move from the mouth down to the stomach.
p3.ex1: He swallowed the junk food mixture without chewing — a spectator to his own health.
p3.ex2: On a diet, swallowing rather than slurping or gulping helps stick to nutritious habits.
p3.example: She chewed every bite of the nutritious bake before swallowing on a full stomach.

p3.uz: tez taom, olib ketish uchun taom
p3.en: A meal bought from a restaurant to eat elsewhere.
p3.ex1: He was addicted to takeaways and found it hard to stick to a diet.
p3.ex2: On a diet, a quick bite of nutritious left-over bake beats a junk food takeaway.
p3.example: She cut out takeaways and replaced them with a nutritious home bake and roast.

p3.en: To give yourself something enjoyable as a special reward.
p3.ex1: He treated himself to a quick bite of dairy and herb roast instead of junk food.
p3.ex2: On a diet, treating yourself to a sip of blended saucepan mixture beats a takeaway.
p3.example: She treated herself to a nutritious bake after a week of sticking to her diet.

p4.en: The feeling of being accepted and part of a group.
p4.ex1: He found a sense of belonging at the sports complex after cutting out junk food.
p4.ex2: Incorporating valued routines creates a sense of belonging that impacts well-being.
p4.example: Sticking to a collective nutritious diet gave her a sense of belonging.

p4.en: Something that is very easy to do.
p4.ex1: Getting in shape automatically feels like a walk in the park once routines are incorporated.
p4.ex2: Cheerful ups and downs aside, sticking to a diet is never a walk in the park.
p4.example: Cutting out junk food was not a walk in the park — she had to turn to valued support.

p4.en: Without thinking about it; as a natural result.
p4.ex1: After cutting out junk food, cheerful habits automatically faded away bad patterns.
p4.ex2: Turning to valued activities automatically impacts well-being and creates belonging.
p4.example: She automatically incorporated nutritious routines that helped lead a healthier life.

p4.ex1: Turning to a collective sense of belonging automatically leads a cheerful, valued life.
p4.ex2: Despite ups and downs, a cheerful walk in the park impacted her diet and well-being.
p4.example: She felt cheerful after incorporating a nutritious routine and getting in shape.

p4.en: To gradually disappear or become less strong.
p4.ex1: The cheerful sense of belonging caused her loneliness to fade away automatically.
p4.ex2: Ups and downs fade away when you surround yourself with valued, cheerful support.
p4.example: Her addiction to junk food faded away after she incorporated nutritious valued routines.

p4.en: To feel accepted and comfortable as part of a group.
p4.ex1: Turning to collective valued routines helped him fit in and lead a healthy life.
p4.ex2: Automatically incorporating nutritious habits helped her fit in and fade away junk food.
p4.example: She fit in at the sports complex and found a cheerful sense of belonging.

p4.en: To go and exercise at a gym.
p4.ex1: Turning to cheerful routines like hitting the gym impacts well-being considerably.
p4.ex2: After incorporating a nutritious diet, hitting the gym felt like a walk in the park.
p4.example: She hit the gym to burn off junk food and get in shape automatically.

p4.en: To have a strong effect on something.
p4.ex1: Turning to valued routines impacts well-being and helps lead a healthy life.
p4.ex2: Ups and downs at the gym impacted her diet but faded away with collective support.
p4.example: Incorporating nutritious habits automatically impacted her cheerful sense of belonging.

p4.en: To include something as part of something else.
p4.ex1: Hitting the gym automatically incorporated a sense of belonging and well-being.
p4.ex2: Turning to collective habits incorporates valued routines that impact long-term health.
p4.example: She incorporated nutritious bakes and roasts to lead a valued, cheerful life.

p4.en: To live in a way that brings happiness or good health.
p4.ex1: Turning to a sense of belonging helps surround yourself with what you need to lead a happy life.
p4.ex2: Ups and downs fade away when you incorporate habits that lead to a valued, healthy life.
p4.example: She incorporated valued routines to automatically lead a cheerful and healthy life.

p4.en: To be or place something all around someone or something.
p4.ex1: Turning to collective routines surrounds you with a sense of belonging automatically.
p4.ex2: Incorporating nutritious habits surrounded her with valued impact on well-being.
p4.example: She surrounded herself with cheerful, valued people who helped her fit in.

p4.en: To seek help or support from someone or something.
p4.ex1: Turning to valued routines automatically incorporates cheerful belonging.
p4.ex2: He turned to collective support to fade away junk food habits and fit in.
p4.example: She turned to the sports complex to hit the gym and lead a healthier life.

p4.ru: взлёты и падения, хорошее и плохое
p4.en: A mixture of good and bad experiences.
p4.ex1: She led a cheerful life despite ups and downs — incorporating valued routines automatically.
p4.ex2: Turning to a sense of belonging helped her cope with the ups and downs of well-being.
p4.example: The ups and downs of sticking to a diet faded away when she hit the gym.

p4.ex1: Turning to valued habits automatically leads a healthy and cheerful life.
p4.ex2: Despite ups and downs, feeling valued fades away loneliness and surrounds you with belonging.
p4.example: She felt valued after incorporating cheerful routines that impacted her sense of belonging.
